title: Chapter 7 of Shaar HaYichud: the general picture of the chain of descent and the unities

lectures.id: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3
Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

overview: Chapter 7 teaches how to make a *hisbonenus*, a contemplation, on the chain of descent (*seder hishtalshelus*). A person first needs the general picture: the whole chain as one connected thing, from G-d's simple unity to our physical world, with its beginning wedged in its end. In brief: after the first *tzimtzum* only an impression, the *reshimu*, was left; from it a *kav* was drawn out; and the *Malchus* of each level becomes the *keser*, the crown, of the level below it, down to *Asiya*. The first two verses of the *Shema* give two general intentions: G-d's essence is one, above even the ten *sefiros*, and His kingship is revealed in the lower unity. Once the whole chain is joined, each detail is one piece against the whole. Kept in mind until fluent, the details let the physical world be seen at once as G-d's expression. The chapter closes in three parts: the chain as one straight line, *yosher*, from the head of *Adam Kadmon* to the heel of *Asiya*; the crowns, which show no real distance between levels; and the simple will, which becomes the will to emanate, to create and to make, with no real difference between them.

terms.gloss: contemplation: the study that brings the details back to one whole
the chain of descent: the order in which the worlds and the sefiros come down from G-d's unity
unification: the contemplation that joins the details into one whole
contraction: G-d's limiting of His self-expression
the impression of the original light left after the tzimtzum
the line of finite light drawn out of the reshimu
encompassing light: the revelation that is the same in everything
crown: the inner desire and drive of a level, given to it by the Malchus above
kingship: the Malchus of each level becomes the crown (keser) of the level below it
the Life of all the worlds: G-d, contracted, as the source of life for everything created
straightness: the chain as one harmonious body, from head to heel

blocks.text: Anyone who studies the *Zohar* and the true Kabbalah texts knows the process of creation, the *seder hishtalshelus*: the chain-like progression of G-dly light through creation, along with the *hitlabshus hapartzufim*, the clothing of one *partzuf* in another. The ten *sefiros* form these *partzufim*, each a face built around one role, all ten working together.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: A face for each role
blocks.text: Take a person who is learning, working, or relaxing. The whole body is used each time, but for one purpose. A parent who needs to educate a child puts on a stern face; in play, a make-believe face, a costume for the role. The love underneath is what is being expressed, and it is expressed through these different masks.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The basic chain, the one every person needs to know, runs from G-d's simple unity, the highest of all stages, down to our lowest physical world, the end of all stages. It is one connection from top to bottom, like a chain, and each stage hangs from the one above it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Reading a book
blocks.text: Ink on paper is the physical layer. Turned into sounds, it is the world of *Yetzira*; into meaning, *Beriya*; into the intent and desire of the author, *Atzilus*; and the author himself, *Adam Kadmon*, and beyond to *Ein Sof*. Once you know how to read, the layers become transparent and you are simply absorbed in the book. In a similar way we are living in G-d's autobiography: everything we see is created by the word of Hashem. It is G-d speaking to us, and we have to learn the language so that the outer layer does not hide the connection.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The point is to see G-d's essence, the simple unity, all the way down to the physical world, through one connected chain. When you pull on the top, it moves the bottom; when you pull on the bottom, it moves the top.

blocks.text: The first light of G-d's simple unity, the cause of all causes, is called the first, *rishon*, or the *kadmon*, the preceding one. *Rishon* means first, like a firstborn: first, but not the source of what comes after. *Kadmon* is a deeper relation, like a parent and child, where what follows depends completely on what comes before it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: *Ani rishon* is the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof* that comes after the first *tzimtzum*, the empty place. The first *ani* is G-d's choice to express His simple essence in this particular way. *Ve-ani acharon* is the lowest *Malchus*, the *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the source of the creation of our physical world. It is still the same choice, and the same G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The lowest expression is as much G-d's choice as the highest. A person designing a house chooses the big things, and also the small ones: the bathroom drapes, how it is built, the little details. So G-d's self-expression reaches from the beginning to the end. Ask why the sky is blue and after a couple of scientific answers you arrive at: that is the way G-d made the world, that is what He wants. Why do things fall? Gravity. Why is there gravity? Because that is the way G-d chose to make it.

blocks.text: The beginning is wedged in the end and the end in the beginning, as it says in *Sefer Yetzira*: G-d's self-expression, the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, is found all the way down in our physical world, and what we do there connects and reveals G-d's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: They become one thing, like a chain whose lowest link is joined to the highest. There are two ways to picture it: a chain running from top to bottom, and a necklace whose last link comes back to the first. So there is a level where we are all linked through the chain of descent, and a deeper level where we are connected directly back to the essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The *ani* at the top and the *ani* at the bottom sit right next to each other, with nothing between them. Once a person comes down to the physical world and recognizes that G-d's choice is still here, there is a direct connection to our world, one that in a way is higher than the higher worlds, because it has a quality of choice and self-expression that is not found there. It is found specifically here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The purpose of a person is to study all the minute details from beginning to end and join them into the general unity of G-d's simple unity, the one called the first. The whole chain has to be seen as one, and G-d's simple essence expressed at every level, down to our physical world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: "I, I am He" means that G-d's simple essence is really found right here. When we look at our physical world we see G-d Himself choosing to express Himself this way. "I am G-d, I have not changed": the chain does not change Him; what is revealed is G-d Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The main foundation of any study of the details is to see how they connect back to the general: everything is drawn back to one whole, all of it expressing G-d's simple unity. For that, first learn the basic beginner's chain, as a framework. When you learn the details later, they snap into place and the big picture is not lost.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The opening of the next class sums up the general picture. In the contemplation a person needs the big picture first, so that as he learns each detail he sees how it connects back to G-d's essence. Once the basic chain is known, the details fall into place.

blocks.text: After the first *tzimtzum* G-d limited His self-expression the way a parent comes down to a small child, or explains something simply to one. Only an impression, a *reshimu*, of the original light is left in the sphere of the *tzimtzum*. From that impression a thin line of finite light, a *kav*, is drawn out, first in an encompassing way, like a circle, then straight, then encompassing again, then straight: a whole process.

blocks.text: The light before the *tzimtzum* is called the upper purity, *tehiru ila'a*. It is not a matter of space. All these levels exist right here together, like the physical text of a book, its sounds and its meaning: we can draw them apart on a diagram, but they are not in different places. The first circle of light after the *tzimtzum*, at the beginning of the *kav*, is the lower purity, *tehiru tata'a*: the general encompassing light for everything that will be revealed in the chain. It is G-d's choice to create our world, one small drop of His potential.

blocks.title: A crown is the inner drive of a level
blocks.text: The *tehiru tata'a* is drawn again through a contraction, the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, and becomes the *keser* of *Adam Kadmon*. The crown is the metaphor: it gives the level its inner source, desire, vitality and drive, the way a crown gives authority. So the process repeats: the *Malchus* of a higher level becomes the *keser* of the level below it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, the first time the *sefiros* are arranged as a person, with three lines of ten, becomes the crown of *Atik Yomin* and *Arich Anpin*, which are at the level of the *keser* of *Atzilus*. Then the chain goes on: the *Malchus* of *Arich Anpin* becomes the crown of the intellectual *partzufim* *Abba* and *Ima*; that of *Abba* and *Ima* the crown of *Zeir Anpin*; that of *Zeir Anpin* the crown of *Nukva*, the female, which is like the idea of husband and wife; and *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becomes the crown of *Beriya*, where the whole pattern repeats. He does not go into the details here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 052 ch 7 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So too from *Beriya* comes *Yetzira*, and from the *Malchus* of *Yetzira* the crown of *Asiya*. The chain ends at the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the end of the whole creation, which makes our physical world.

blocks.title: A builder's desire and a person's essence
blocks.text: *Sovev* is the general light that relates to what comes after it. A general desire to build a building is already aimed at some particular thing outside itself. A person's essence is different: it permeates everything he does, not for the sake of any goal, but because he is himself. It leaves its imprint on all he does, and it has no above and below and no hierarchy. It pervades everything by its nature.

blocks.title: The phone call
blocks.text: When you speak on the phone you do not think of the microphone, the digital signals, the towers and the satellites. You know all that is happening, but once you know it is all connected, you say, I was talking to him. Reading is the same: once you learn to read, the letters and the sounds become transparent and you feel the connection to the writer. So too, G-d created physical and spiritual laws, but once you see that it is all G-d choosing at the top to pull the strings, whatever you see down here becomes a direct expression of His will.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So we see how everything is really revealing and expressing G-d's essence, which is higher than the whole process, and how everything unites to its source, the essence of the infinite light before the *tzimtzum*. In simple terms, *Or Ein Sof* is that G-d could do whatever He wants: everything is an expression of His choice and His freedom to express Himself however He wishes.

blocks.text: The general intention when reading the first verse of the *Shema*, "Hashem is one," is the upper *yichud*: to recognize G-d's simple unity, the essence before the first *tzimtzum*, which is a completely simple unity.

blocks.text: This is the most general intention of all the study: to recognize G-d's simple unity, how He transcends everything in the world, and how everything is, in the end, an expression of His essence and His choice. *Sefer Yetzira* says, "Before one, what can you count?" G-d's essence transcends the whole chain, even the ten *sefiros*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: G-d is above the ten *sefiros*, and above the very idea of *sefiros*, as the *Pasach Eliyahu* says: "You are one, not by calculation." The *Arizal* explains that G-d is not an eleventh *sefira* above the ten, nor the totality of them. He could create infinite *sefiros*, and things beyond the idea of a *sefira* altogether. A *sefira* is an avatar, a form He creates for Himself to be revealed in our world.

blocks.text: The second general intention is the verse "Blessed be the name of the glory of His kingship forever and ever," the lower unity. Once we recognize that everything comes from G-d, we see His essence expressed in the lower unity of the world, in the choices He makes in how the world runs. We do not only recognize that G-d transcends everything; we come back into the world and find Him in what is around us.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The choice to express Himself in creation begins with the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof* after the *tzimtzum*, and goes through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* until it reaches the *Malchus* of *Asiya*. That is the "I am first and I am last." The word "I" here stands for *Malchus*, a person's self-expression: G-d's self-expression at the beginning of the chain is "I am first," and the way He expresses Himself in choosing the physical world at the end is "I am last."

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: A person's choices
blocks.text: The same is true of a person: he makes high-level decisions, such as which city to live in and what career to pursue, and small ones, like what to eat for lunch. The little choices express him just as much, in a certain way more. This is one of the unique things about art and poetry: finding meaning in the smallest things, which encapsulate deep things.

blocks.title: A house and a chart
blocks.text: The first circle that surrounds the finite line is the general light that unites them all. Drawings and charts of the chain are a help at first, like a Venn diagram: the circles show relationships, not places. The circle stands for a person's choice to build a house. The house, and the whole process of building it, is one detail among the infinite possibilities within the bigger sphere, all the houses he could have built. Even building a home is one detail of how a person expresses himself; his real essence transcends his outer expressions.

blocks.text: This whole chain, even the spiritual worlds, is one detail compared with the essence of the infinite light before the *tzimtzum*, the *tehiru ila'a*, the upper purity: G-d's self-expression as it is, which transcends being expressed in anything outside Him.

blocks.text: "Holy and removed" means the essence. It is higher than both the general and the particular. A person's desire to build a house is already somewhat localized, even though its possibilities are infinite. His inner style and taste are general, expressed in everything he does, yet not defined by any one of them. That is the upper purity: G-d's true Self, not limited to any specific expression. Everything is within G-d's essence, beyond any being expressed in the world or the chain.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: "The Life of the Worlds is king": this sovereignty comes from G-d's kingship. The phrase "G-d is one" in the prayer means that His essence is *Yachid*, singular and alone and transcendent.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: From the singular essence, through the first *tzimtzum*, He becomes the *chai kol ha'olamim*, the Life of all the worlds, and He reveals Himself in two ways. The *makif* is the transcendent revelation, the same in everything: the idea of choice behind every thing. The *pnimi* is the internal revelation, the unique qualities and function of each thing. The general metaphor is a person's will, which is expressed in every part of the body about the same, but also localized: sight in the eye, feeling in the heart.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Once a person has studied all the details and sees how they connect, he sees how everything expresses G-d's transcendent essence beyond the chain, and then plugs that back into the chain. This is very much connected to the last chapter: a person's motivation has to be for G-d's transcendent essence, and then brought back down to see that in the world and in everything around us.

sections.title: Train the mind, then see G-d's essence in the physical world at once
sections.summary: After the details are learned, a person keeps them in mind until the long chain is fluent. Then, in one moment, he sees in the physical world how it was created from nothing and sees G-d's hand in it: the highest *Malchus* of *Ein Sof* is found specifically in the final physical creation.

blocks.title: Learning to read
blocks.text: At first reading is a very long process: each letter's shape and sound, sounding out a word, slowly decoding the meaning and the grammar. Once you are fluent, it becomes transparent, and you forget you are doing it at all. The chain of descent is the same: you want to see the connections from top to bottom and bottom to top as one unit.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Any subject is like this. When a person masters it, so much becomes second nature that he makes it look easy. When you teach it, you have to break it down, and each skill and step has to be mastered on its own; then, put together, it flows. That is what we are after, like a musical instrument or a language: hard at first, fluent once it is familiar.

phrases.he: עד שברגע א' ממש בהתבונן בנפשו בסוף הכל, שהוא השגות איכות התהוות יש מאין הגשם דגלגלים וד' יסודות הגשמיים וכל פרטי עולם הזה השפל
phrases.en: and we want that eventually, in just one moment, literally, it should just take one second, that when a person thinks about things in the physical world, about how the physical world is created through the physical *galgalim*, like the different planets and different cycles and the weather, and the four physical elements of our world, and all the details of our lowly physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: like it says, lift your eyes up

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and see who created all of these

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: In other words, thinking about their physical creation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: this finalmost *tzimtzum*, that's creating the physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שבזה ממש שורה בבחינת אין סוף דוקא
phrases.en: that G-d's essence, this infinite *Ein Sof*, his unlimited ability, is found here specifically

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: the highest beginning and the source of the entire *seder hishtalshelus*

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת מלכות דאין סוף שלפני מקור האצי'
phrases.en: that *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, which is higher even than the source of *Atzilus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The goal is that a person, in one moment, literally one second, thinking about the physical world, sees how it was created: the *galgalim*, the planets and cycles and weather, the four physical elements, all the details of this lowly world, brought from nothing into being.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Lift your eyes
blocks.text: The verse says "lift up your eyes" and "see who created these." In its plain sense, you look at the heavens and the stars and ask who made them. Take a walk, smell the roses, look at the beauty and wonder of the world. We should right away see G-d's hand and His g-dliness in it, and see how He reveals Himself in these physical things. That is the ultimate goal: to appreciate what we see in the physical world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This final *tzimtzum*, the one that creates the physical world, is where the infinite is found specifically: the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof* that is above even the source of *Atzilus* is expressed in our physical world more than in all the spiritual worlds.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

sections.title: Why the Psalms praise G-d in the physical world
sections.summary: The praise of G-d in the Psalms is found in the physical world, in the plain sense, and the main praise is found down here, in the end of the chain.

phrases.he: וע"כ לא נזכר בכל ספר תהלים בשבחי גדולת יהו״ה רק בדרך פשוט, בגדולות ונפלאות מעשה יהו״ה בשמים וארץ וכל צבאם הגשמיים דוקא
phrases.en: And this is why when you look in the *Book of Psalms*, and King David is writing about the glory of *Hashem* and the praises of G-d, he speaks about the physical world: the looking around at creation, the simple things about our physical world, the heavens, the earth, and all the creatures in it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ולא נזכר שבחי גדולתו בעולמות העליונים רוחניים עד רום המעלות שלפני האצילות
phrases.en: he doesn't mention G-d's praise by talking about the spiritual worlds, all the way up to higher than *Atzilus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כו' מפני שנעוץ תחלתן בסופן דוקא
phrases.en: that the beginning is wedged in the end

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: like we mentioned previously

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב אני אני הוא ממש

phrases.he: וכו' ועצמיות אור אין סוף הוא הסובב
phrases.en: and the essence of G-d's light is actually what surrounds and pervades everything

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The Psalms praise G-d in the plain sense: through the great and wonderful works in heaven and earth and all their physical creatures. They do not praise Him through the spiritual worlds.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The praise does not reach the spiritual worlds, up to just above *Atzilus*, because the main praise of G-d is found down here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The beginning is wedged in the end, and G-d's essence is found specifically down here, without anything in between. The metaphor is a circle: as you draw a line down it, the bottom of the circle brings you back to its outside, and as we get lower, we come close to the edge of the circle, which is the essence of G-d's light.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Studying the *seder hishtalshelus* should not pull us away from the physical world, into thinking about high spiritual things, angels and *sefiros*. We want to understand those ideas in order to appreciate what is in front of us and around us. That is where the real essence is, a direct experience of G-dliness, and we have to learn to appreciate it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Intellectual models and philosophy are not where real truth lies. Real truth is in the direct experience of physical things, and science shows it: any theory has to be tested by experiment, and the experiments, not the elegance of the idea, are the measure of truth. The spiritual ideas are a way of expressing the truth that is here in the physical world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is why we are focused on the physical performance of the *mitzvos*, on how we actually act and behave in the physical world, and on seeing G-d in the world around us and appreciating its beauty and wonder. There are many stories of the *Ba'al Shem Tov* going out to the forest to appreciate nature.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וזהו אמיתית המכוון בהתבוננות בפרט כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: and this is the real intention when studying the details of the *seder hishtalshelus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and even though a person can think, well, if I start counting all the levels of the *seder hishtalshelus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: they seem to be very far away from the beginning to the end of the *seder hishtalshelus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אבל באמת קרוב מאד בלי הפסק והסתר כלל באמצע
phrases.en: but the truth is that it's very near and G-d is actually right here physically with us, in our physical world, without anything separating in between

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב אני אני הוא ומבלעדי באמצעיתא
phrases.en: like it says, "I, I am He, without anything in between."

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The real intention in studying the details is not only to know the high spiritual levels. It is to see G-d's essence, which transcends everything, as the first step; and then to see that essence all the way down in our physical world, connecting what is higher than the whole chain to its bottom.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: If you count the levels of the chain one by one, they seem very far from beginning to end. In truth G-d is very near, physically with us in our world, with nothing separating or hiding Him in between.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: "I, I am He, without anything in between." First one must understand "I am first and I am last," the chain. Like learning a language, step by step, this goes away once you have mastered it, and the real essence of a person's expression is found in its final, lowest physical expression. The speaker is trying to connect from his soul straight to the listener. He uses all these things only as a way of doing it. In the same way, this is a deeper thing: we are not even something separate from G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We actually are G-d Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

sensitivity.reason: A provocative Torah position, that the soul is G-d Himself, stated as the class's own teaching and not as a quotation; a reader could take it as a claim about people that the text does not hedge.
sensitivity.publishable: We are not something separate from G-d.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: Decide whether this prints as said (a Torah position on the essence of the soul, stated as such) or as replaced. The publishable text keeps the point that nothing separates us from G-d and drops the identity claim.

sections.title: Yosher: the chain as one straight line, not a set of circles
sections.summary: The chain taken as one straight line from the head of *Adam Kadmon* to the heel of *Asiya* is *yosher*, where everything harmonizes as one body. People, by nature, see the same chain as circles of hierarchy, and that makes the distance seem large.

phrases.he: (וכמו שכתוב כי האלהי״ם עשה את האדם
phrases.en: It says that G-d made man

phrases.en: the original man, which is this line of light of the *seder hishtalshelus*

phrases.en: this finite, this process of creation, G-d made it straight

phrases.en: And this is all created in a way that's called *yosher*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and the idea of *yosher* is that everything harmonizes perfectly and works together as a single unit, from beginning to end

phrases.he: כו' בפירוד והתחלקות זה למעלה מזה
phrases.en: where each level is distinct and separate and one is higher than the other, and there's this clear hierarchy

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The verse says G-d made man straight, and then people seek calculations. In its plain sense, G-d makes a person sincere, good and straight, and then he starts to learn to lie, cheat and connive. In the Mitteler Rebbe's style, he quotes a verse and weaves the explanation into it: here he first says the whole verse, then goes back and explains it piece by piece.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: G-d made the original man, the line of light of the chain: finite, but straight from top to bottom, from its head to the heel of *Adam Kadmon*, which ends at the end of *Asiya*. *Adam Kadmon* is the general, G-dly image of the basic pattern of the chain and the *sefiros*, and it is like the soul of the whole chain. So the heel of it is found all the way down in *Asiya*, in the way of *yosher*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The whole chain is complete inclusion from its head to its end, and this is what is called *yosher*. The people, though, sought many calculations, in the form of circles: a scheme in which each level is distinct and separate, one above the other, a clear hierarchy.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: In the realm of *yosher* we see all of reality as one body, the way the organs of a body or the instruments of a symphony differ and yet each needs the others. Our differences express that we are interdependent, parts of one greater whole, and that no organ can live on its own.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This is how G-d created the chain, in the way of *yosher*, where we are all interdependent and one entity, and very near to G-d. But people by nature like to classify and make hierarchies, and the circles make us feel distant from whatever level we imagine we must reach to be connected to G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

sections.title: The crowns show no distance, and the simple will is one will
sections.summary: The crowns of each world show no real distance between levels: they flow as one thing. The simple will of G-d's essence becomes the will to emanate, to create and to make, with no real difference between them.

phrases.he: ויובן כל הנזכר לעיל בדרך קצרה מאד
phrases.en: we can understand all of this in a very short way

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: the example is of the *keser*, which means a crown, and this idea of the desire or choice that's motivating each stage

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: that in the *kesarim*, in the desires, there is not

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בחינת השתלשלות עילה ועלול בריחוק המדרגה כלל
phrases.en: there's not this very distant cause-and-effect type of relationship

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The crowns, the *keser* of each world, show the same thing in a short way. A crown is the desire or choice that motivates each stage. Taken that way, a long process can be seen as one unit.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: In the crowns there is no chain of cause and effect with distance between the levels. They flow together as one thing, in a natural and interconnected way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו בחינת הרצון הפשוט שבעצמיות אור אין סוף,
phrases.en: So for example, G-d's simple desire, that G-d has this power, so to speak, to choose whatever he wants, which is part of the essence of the infinite light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב כשעלה ברצונו הפשוט כו', בחינת מלכות דאין סוף עצמה
phrases.en: and so once it arose in his desire that he is going to create a world and express himself as like a king, as being revealed through something separate from himself, that's the idea of *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: And that's this idea that G-d said I'm going to be king

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כו' שהוא למעלה מרצון להאציל או לברוא
phrases.en: That is still, that essential desire is something that transcends the desire to emanate the *sefiros* or create the world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The simple will in the essence of the infinite light is the power to choose whatever He wants. Once it arose in His will to create a world and reveal Himself as king through something separate from Himself, that is the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*: within the infinite range of what He can choose, He chooses *Malchus*. G-d said, "I am going to be king," which is above the will to emanate or to create. That essential desire transcends the will to make the world; He chose to reveal Himself this way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: it's still this essential ability that could be expressed in unlimited ways

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וממנו נתצמצם תחילה בחינת רצון הקדום
phrases.en: and from that, G-d first limited this desire

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: which is called the *keser*, the inner desire for *Adam Kadmon*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and then that became the desire to make the world of *Atzilus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: that's the desire for *Atzilus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and then I want to create

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and then it became the *keser* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*

phrases.en: until the desire of *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: it's the desire to enact it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Still, it is only the *hiyuli*, the raw potential, that can be expressed in unlimited ways. From that potential G-d first limited the desire, the *ratzon kadum*, the preceding will, which is the *keser* of *Adam Kadmon*: the will to create our universe with the ten *sefiros*, with man in it, and with G-d as king over people.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Then the will to emanate, the *keser* of *Atzilus* in general: G-d's desire to make the ten *sefiros* in their G-dly form, the world of *Atzilus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Then the will to create: the *keser* of the *Malchus* of *Beriya*, and then the *keser* of the *Malchus* of *Yetzira* and so on down to *Asiya*: the desire to make the form of things, trees and squirrels and people, and then how it is actually done, the chemical and physical processes that make our world as we know it. The will to do it is the last of these.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה עשה
phrases.en: like it says, everything that G-d desires, he did

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: And if we think, for example, in a person, we see that there's not really a difference

phrases.he: בבחינת רצונו ועצמותו ההיולי שהיה כלול בו ד' רצונות
phrases.en: when you look from the perspective of a person's essential desire, that I have choice and I can choose to do what I want. And even though that can be the source for these four different types of desires

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו רצון לעצמות גופו לרצון לפעול ולעשות היותר אחרון,
phrases.en: the desire for my own self and my own body to be preserved, and then the desire for me to express that, let's say, in thought, speech, and action in different ways

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: those are all coming from my essence, and they're all expressing that same essential power of desire

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 07/Shaar HaYichud 053 ch 7 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כו' כך אין הפרש ממש בין בחינת רצונו הפשוט שנמשך להיות רצון להאציל,

blocks.title: One will in four dresses
blocks.text: A person's essential will shows four kinds of desire: for his own self and body to be preserved, and for him to express that in thought, speech and action. They all come from one root and one source, the same essential power of desire, in different forms. They are in a different mode and a different dress, but the essence is the same.

blocks.text: So too, from the perspective of G-d's essence, there is no real difference between His simple will as the will to emanate and His simple will as the desire behind what He does in the lowest world of our *Asiya*.

blocks.text: G-d chose to make the *sefiros* with the nature they have, and rocks, trees and plants with theirs. So it is just as G-dly: His self-expression is in the details of how He creates and runs everything, as much as in the higher worlds. Everything is connected from top to bottom, and this is one example.

blocks.text: Learn all the details, since they give a rich and true understanding, but start from the view that everything is connected, and do not let the details make you feel far away.

blocks.title: A little child who keeps asking why
blocks.text: A simple exercise for making a *yichud*: be a little child who asks why. Why is the sky blue? Because G-d chose that color, and you need not go into the science. Why do things fall? Gravity. Why gravity? Keep asking three to five times and you run out of answers, because all our systems of logic work within assumptions, that the world is a certain way and that the framework is a certain way. Ask why the world is that way, and you quickly arrive at G-d's essence: it did not have to be this way, nobody knows why, G-d chose it. So we see G-d's hand very near in everything. Do not get stuck feeling that the levels are far off, or that you are higher than someone because you know this, G-d forbid. See it as a simple truth, all around us, and something uniting.
